item.title: Resistance to data centers fuels flood of Georgia bills targeting the industry
item.description: Anger and opposition to the rapid rise of data centers across Georgia has led to a surge of bills that would clamp down on the resource-consuming industry. The post Resistance to data centers fuels flood of Georgia bills targeting the industry appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Columbia County Conservation District accepting entries for poster contest
item.description: The Columbia County Soil and Water Conservation District is accepting entries for its annual poster contest for students in Columbia County. The post Columbia County Conservation District accepting entries for poster contest appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Columbia County BOE recognizes student achievements, hears budget outlook
item.description: The Columbia County Board of Education opened its Jan. 27 work session by recognizing district accomplishments in fine arts and academics, then moved through routine business before spotlighting Greenbrier High School and hearing a budget and legislative outlook presentation focused on state-level decisions and rising benefit costs. The post Columbia County BOE recognizes student achievements, hears budget outlook appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: No surprises on first day of qualifying for HD 130
item.description: Two Democrats and one Republican qualified Tuesday in the quick-turnaround Georgia House District 130 special election. The post No surprises on first day of qualifying for HD 130 appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: ARCCA highlights timeframe for completion of new arena
item.description: The Augusta-Richmond County Coliseum Authority (ARCCA) now has the recorded deed for the property between Sixth and Fenwick streets, ARCCA attorney Edward Enoch told authority board members during the authority’s meeting, Tuesday. item.title: Officials tease ‘preliminary response’ to HCD audit
item.description: The Augusta Commission received a "preliminary response" to an ongoing audit of the Housing and Community Development department at a closed meeting Tuesday. The post Officials tease ‘preliminary response’ to HCD audit appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Two arrested after reported gun incident triggers lockdown at Aiken school
